bluf: NWS Winter Storm Warning for St. Louis City and County, noon Wed to 6 PM Thu: 3-8 in. heavy wet snow, heaviest Wed night into early Thu, changing to rain Thu midday with gusts to 30 mph. Classes are on break, so the risk is a thinly staffed campus with break-housing residents, the Thu 6-7 AM Medical Campus shift change, the Thu 8 AM Forest Park Turkey Trot, limb-down outages, and Fri-Sat melt into West Campus below-grade archives. Saturday is the week's peak: first home NCAA football playoff game at noon. No life-safety, health or infrastructure trigger touches a WashU asset.
